The '''Outer Rim Command Center''' was a base used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], located somewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] transferred here after sustaining damages in a [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|battle]].<ref name="Lair of Grievous Decoded">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous|d=y}}</ref>
